brief: Finds where a formula of named variables is smallest or largest, starting from a point, and reports how the search ended.
detail: Build one with new stzObjective("(x-1)^2 + (y-2)^2", [ "x", "y" ]). The search is L-BFGS on the exact gradient of the formula, with no constraints; for linear constraints use stzLinearSolver. MinimizeFrom and MaximizeFrom answer a record, not a bare point, because a bare point cannot say it did not converge: read :status and :why, and :evaluations for the real cost. The result is a local extremum, so different starts can end at different points. SetMaxIterations and SetGradientTolerance tune the stop. Status words are lowercase: converged, settled, maxiterations, linesearchfailed, notfinite.
